submitted.rationale: XRD at Fe fractions 0.74, 0.53 and 0.30 all showed the same rutile-type pattern, so phase alone could not pick a winner. EQE rose steadily as Fe increased: 0.0017% at Fe 0.48 (index 10), 0.060% at Fe 0.71 (index 5) and 0.136% at Fe 0.81 (index 2). Index 2 is the best measured composition. The peak may lie at even higher Fe (indices 0–1), but no merit budget was left to check.
